title: Refutation
summary: REFUTA'TION, noun [Latin refutatio. See Refute.] The act or process of refuting or disproving; the act of proving to be false or erroneous; the overthrowing of an argument, opinion, testimony, doctrin

inlines.v: REFUTA'TION, noun [Latin refutatio. See Refute.] The act or process of refuting or disproving; the act of proving to be false or erroneous; the overthrowing of an argument, opinion, testimony, doctrine or theory, by argument or countervailing proof.
